description: The Sri Lankan leopard is the island's apex predator, ruling both dry scrubs and cloudy mountain hills. Highly solitary and masterfully camouflaged, they play a critical role in managing herbivore numbers, keeping Sri Lanka's unique ecosystems in perfect, delicate balance.
shortBlurb: A master of camouflage unique to the island's coastal dry scrublands and rainforests.

description: An incredible long-tailed leaf-eating monkey found only in Sri Lanka's closed canopy forests. Their haunting, loud whooping calls can be heard echoing through the dense woods at dawn.
shortBlurb: An incredible leaf-eating monkey found only in dense wet zone forests.

description: Also known as the Indian Pangolin, this elusive, scaly anteater is a primarily nocturnal creature. Sadly, they are highly threatened due to illegal poaching for their scales and meat.
shortBlurb: A rare, armored mammal threatened by illegal poaching.
